name: Goal24 Checkpoint 6 Lane A - Evidence Core + Provider Registry + Qualification Runtime
base_note: origin/dev/goal24-cli-skills, verified exact after git fetch --all --tags --prune
commit_sha_note: code/test tip at the time this manifest was written; the manifest itself is committed as the branch tip immediately after

commits.message: feat(evidence): add provider registry and evidence model
feat(evidence): qualify evidence into coverage snapshots
test(evidence): harden freshness provenance and conflict handling

evidence_id_algorithm: SHA-256 lowercase hex over provider_id \u0000 evidence_class \u0000 subject_key \u0000 source_item_id \u0000 claim_digest; deterministic; providers cannot choose or spoof final ids; cross-provider collision impossible for same source_item_id
claim_digest_algorithm: canonicalJson(claim_value) with object keys stably sorted, array order preserved, primitives via canonical JSON form, non-JSON-safe input rejected -> SHA-256 lowercase hex; JSON.stringify insertion order can never change the digest

provider_contract.result_shape: strict { outcome, candidates <= 10000, diagnostics <= 1000 }; diagnostics strict { code, message }
provider_contract.exception_normalization: thrown non-abort errors and malformed result shapes normalize to temporary_unavailable + EVIDENCE_PROVIDER_ERROR diagnostic; original exception text withheld (no secret leak)
provider_contract.abort: EVIDENCE_COLLECTION_ABORTED before start, on AbortError, and when a result lands after the signal aborted

exposed_over: none (not MCP, not REST, not Tauri IPC, not LLM tools)
provider_registry.duplicate_policy: provider_id unique; same id with different instance/version rejected with EVIDENCE_PROVIDER_DUPLICATE

freshness.clock: injected now; no Date.now() in qualification
freshness.boundary: age == max_age_ms fresh; age > max_age_ms stale; no freshness_policy -> never age-stale

qualification.verification_none_semantics: verification_level=none with structurally/provenance-valid candidate is a legal present state when the requirement allows none; status=unverified is reserved for candidates the core cannot recognize (or collection limit failures)

coverage_builder.output: { snapshot: EvidenceCoverageSnapshot (parsed through EvidenceCoverageSnapshotSchema), diagnostics, diagnostics_truncated }
coverage_builder.checked_at: injected now on every entry; providers can never set checked_at
coverage_builder.conflict_detection: structural only: same evidence_class + subject_key + claim_key with different canonical claim digests; no LLM semantic classification
coverage_builder.conflict_partition: per claim_key, primary = highest provider priority (tie -> lexical evidence_id); primary plus same-digest candidates -> evidence_ids; disagreeing candidates -> conflict_evidence_ids; disjoint and sorted
coverage_builder.corroboration: multiple agreeing providers -> status=present with multiple evidence_ids
coverage_builder.aggregate_verification: highest qualified verification level among the fresh agreeing candidates

bounds.fail_closed: EVIDENCE_COLLECTION_LIMIT_EXCEEDED -> class entry status=unverified, qualification blocked for that class, diagnostics truncated with explicit flag

coverage: verification none + requirement none -> present with verification_level none
verification none + requirement verified -> snapshot present/none and assessEvidenceCoverage blocks
freshness age == max fresh / age == max + 1 stale
no candidate -> missing; only invalid candidates -> unverified
two conflicting providers -> conflicted with disjoint partition
stale disagreement + fresh valid -> fresh valid wins
deterministic evidence ids and claim digests
object key reordering -> same claim digest
coverage includes every requirement (mandatory and optional)
collection bounds fail closed (all five limits)
assessEvidenceCoverage integration: mandatory missing/stale/unverified block, undeclared conflict policy reject, warn tolerated, optional missing non-blocking

verification.vitest: PASS (826 passed, 0 failed, 49 files; 63 new CP6 tests)
verification.lint: PASS (0 errors; only pre-existing warnings outside this lane; no warnings in CP6 files)

known_residual_risks: Guard-level timeout orchestration, retrieve_more/clarify/defer and Decision Kernel wiring are Lane B; CP6 exposes only the AbortSignal contract and the snapshot
The class subject is taken from the first canonical batch; collecting one class for multiple subjects requires separate builds
Provider trust is registration-time trust of application code; dynamic plugin/provider loading is a separate security checkpoint
source_reference content is provider-supplied; the core bounds its length but cannot verify its secret-free content
This lane ships only deterministic fake providers; GitHub live / HTTP / MCP providers belong to later lanes

environment.policy: D: first, then existing C:; new installs only under D:\environment
